title: a11y-elements
sublead: A behavior layer, not a themed UI kit.
light-dom: Every element is Light DOM only: it enhances real markup you author yourself, and you style it with your own CSS.
elements-desc: Anchor, avatar, card link, checkbox, checkbox group, file input, focusable, input, label, picture, progress, radio group, select, skeleton, spinner, switch, textarea and visually-hidden.
overlays-desc: Blocking loader, context menu, drawer, dropdown, emergency dialog, floating, modal, notification banner, popover, snackbar and tooltip.
